scope: Simple hardware parts, prices and functions in the existing GitHub Pages walkthrough

arithmetic.checks: Every quantity times unit price equals its line price; each basket equals its line sum; observed and estimated splits reconcile with dated source records.

verification.syntax: web/app.js, web/parts.js and web/parts-data.js passed node --check
verification.source_validation: Passed; pinned SONIC v1 manuscript checksum unchanged
verification.browser: Installed Chrome via bundled Playwright, local HTTP preview
verification.layout_scope: All five lists at all three widths: no page horizontal overflow, no broken product images, no browser script errors or local HTTP failures.
interactions: Every line item and quantity displayed
Each list total and candidate-only subtotal
Default home and entry to parts list
verification.visual_inspection: Desktop and narrow Basic lists inspected; lists show only the part/photo, short function, price and total. Captures remain ignored temporary files.

images: 14 authentic manufacturer product-reference photos; per-file URLs and configuration caveats in web/assets/parts/sources.json
evidence_boundary: Prices are dated planning observations/estimates. Equipment inventory, borrowed availability, recorder interfaces, source-to-speaker bandwidth, acoustic accuracy and neural alignment remain unverified. OmniMic is a separate USB calibration candidate, not a validated direct-NI microphone replacement. Rice sedation differs from the awake SONIC preparation.
actions: Website implementation and software/source checks only. No vendor contact, order, sound playback, hardware control, bench work or animal experiment.
